picks.name: Logic1000
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Confirmation!" (October 2, 2026, Therapy/Because Music) is her second studio album -- ten tracks featuring KUCKA, Jam City, Christine and the Queens, FAUZIA and yunè pinkù, spanning deep house, UK funky, breakbeat and tech house.
picks.why_listen: A high-profile, guest-stacked album from a dependable favorite -- bouncy, vocal-forward club tracks with real crossover range.

picks.name: Hodge
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Big Splash" (October 2, 2026, Local Action) is his second full-length album and first since 2020's Shadows In Blue -- eight dancefloor-first house tracks inspired by deeper moments on the dance floor.
picks.why_listen: A fresh full-length from a dependable Bristol producer -- straightforward, well-built house tracks that translate across genre lines.
